buildCommand: cd .. && bun run --filter @stackmap/viewer build && cd site && bun run build
ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ../packages ../skill ../package.json ../tsconfig.base.json ../bun.lock; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
